name: codex-feishu-bridge-desktop
description: Windows desktop client for Codex Feishu Bridge
author: Codex Feishu Bridge contributors

scripts.check: node --check scripts/generate-icons.cjs && node --check scripts/stage-engine.cjs && node --check scripts/write-checksums.cjs && node --check scripts/verify-release.cjs && powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$errors = $null; [void][System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile('scripts/verify-installed-upgrade.ps1', [ref]$null, [ref]$errors); if ($errors.Count) { $errors | ForEach-Object { Write-Error $_ }; exit 1 }" && node --check src/main/index.cjs && node --check src/main/services/environment.cjs && node --check src/main/services/bridge-discovery.cjs && node --check src/main/services/capabilities.cjs && node --check src/main/services/engine.cjs && node --check src/main/services/known-paths.cjs && node --check src/main/services/bot-setup.cjs && node --check src/main/services/feishu-registration.cjs && node --check src/main/services/lark-user-auth.cjs && node --check src/main/services/supervisor.cjs && node --check src/main/services/bot-readiness.cjs && node --check src/main/services/permission-policy.cjs && node --check src/main/services/provider-manager.cjs && node --check src/main/services/protocol-proxy.cjs && node --check src/main/services/managed-removal.cjs && node --check src/main/services/workspace-factory.cjs && node --check src/main/services/desktop-settings.cjs && node --check src/main/services/recovery-supervisor.cjs && node --check src/main/services/update-policy.cjs && node --check src/main/services/update-recovery.cjs && node --check src/main/services/updater.cjs && node --check src/main/services/windows-startup.cjs && node --check src/main/services/capability-migration.cjs && node --check src/main/services/provider-setup.cjs && node --check src/main/services/data-migrations.cjs && node --check src/main/services/compatibility.cjs && node --check src/preload/index.cjs && node --check src/renderer/app.js && node --test test/*.test.cjs
scripts.start: npm run proxy:install && npm run stage:engine && electron .
scripts.pack: npm run proxy:install && npm run generate:icons && npm run stage:engine && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist:win: npm run proxy:install && npm run smoke:protocol-proxy && npm run generate:icons && npm run stage:engine && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never && npm run checksums && npm run verify:release
